# Compliance allowlist — reviewed, intentional disclaimer language.
#
# WHY THIS EXISTS
# The constitution checks in constitution-check.yml are literal regex scans.
# They cannot tell a prohibition from a promise, so the project's own safety
# text trips them. For example, under the heading "What this system does NOT
# do", the bullet "- Replace clinical judgment" matches the scope-drift
# pattern 'replace clinical judgment' even though it asserts the opposite.
#
# Every line below is an exact disclaimer that has been reviewed and is
# allowed to match. Anything NOT listed here still fails the build, so new
# genuine violations are caught as before.
#
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are stripped before use.
# Entries are matched as fixed substrings against grep output, so they must
# be specific enough not to mask a real violation.

# docs/architecture.md — "What this system does NOT do" list
- Diagnose conditions or recommend treatments
- Replace clinical judgment
- Process real PHI (synthetic data only for this MVP)

# docs/architecture.md — section 5.4 Safety & Guardrails
- **No real PHI**: All data is synthetic; no HIPAA obligations but architecture is PHI-ready

# app/streamlit_app.py — module docstring safety declaration
Synthetic data only — no real PHI.
This tool does not diagnose, does not predict outcomes, and does not recommend treatment.

# specs/004-patient360-curation — read model contract
- The read model does not assume real PHI.

# sql/patient360_personas.sql — audit table COMMENT asserting immutability.
# Matches 'DELETE.*audit' only because it states that no DELETE path exists.
Insert-only by design: no UPDATE or DELETE path is provided by the application
